messages:
Maya: Heads-up — I'm assembling the EBR deck for AcmeCorp next Tue 10am PT. Need exec alignment on renewal ask + 90-day playbook. Draft here: https://drive.internal/acme/ebr-draft :spiral_calendar:
Ravi: I'll own the renewal ask slide. Need ARR delta + churn signal. @Maya can you confirm the target renewal date?
Maya: Renewal window ends May 20. Goal is to lock >95% of current ARR, or surface tradeoffs.
Sam: I can pull usage trends + forecast. Which granularity — weekly or monthly?
Maya: Monthly is fine for execs; include last 6 months + 3-month projection.
Priya: I'll add onboarding gaps + enablement action items. I have recent feedback from the success survey to include.
Carlos: Health still amber — ingestion pipeline lagging. Linked incident: INC-2026-113. Short mitigation plan: scale workers + config tweak.
Jen: Who's presenting to execs? I can help format a 1-slide TL;DR.
Maya: I'll present. Jen — please do the exec one-pager. Needs to show 3 asks, 2 risks, 1 win.
ops-bot: Reminder: rehearsal slot available 2026-04-11 16:00 PT (60m). Use /book-rehearsal to reserve.
Maya: Action items: 1) Ravi — ARR scenarios & recommended discount tiers; 2) Priya — onboarding gap slide + quotes; 3) Sam — usage forecast chart; 4) Carlos — mitigation timeline for ingestion; 5) Jen — compile exec one-pager and speaker notes.
Ravi: ack. I'll model two pricing scenarios (no discount / -10%) and include recommended concession. ETA: EOD Thu.
Priya: ack. I'll include anonymized customer quotes and a short enablement timeline (30/60/90).
Carlos: I'll paste a short diagnostic snippet into the doc and attach the runbook. Quick logs: ```kubectl get pods -n acme | grep ingestion
ingestion-worker-1   Running   3/3   48m
ingestion-worker-2   CrashLoopBackOff   1/3   12m```
Sam: I'll attach a monthly usage chart and a forecast with confidence bands. Will also add correlation with feature X adoption.
Jen: I'll draft the one-pager layout and drop it in the deck. Need final asks by Fri 9am PT to build speaker notes.
Maya: Can someone pull renewal risk indicators? Net dollar retention, top-3 churn reasons from support tickets, and exec sentiment?
Ravi: NDR: 98% yoy. Support shows 4 tickets in last 30 days referencing onboarding/API keys.
Priya: Customer quote to include: "Great latency overall, but onboarding docs unclear around API keys and sample payloads." I'll anonymize and add context.
Maya: @ops-bot please book rehearsal for 2026-04-11 16:00 PT and enable recording.
ops-bot: Booked: Rehearsal for AcmeCorp EBR — 2026-04-11 16:00 PT (60m). Calendar invites sent to Maya, Ravi, Sam, Priya, Carlos, Jen. Recording enabled.
Maya: Also pinging @VP-Sales for pricing signal in case they want to attach ACV commitments. @Ravi can you include recommended deal economics in the slide?
Ravi: Will include two scenarios + recommended concession language.
Jen: Small ask — can we have one backup slide with recent support SLA metrics in case execs dig in?
Carlos: I'll provide the incident timeline and mitigation ETA to include on the backup slide.
Sam: Forecast and chart will be in by Thu noon.
Priya: I'll upload the enablement checklist and suggested customer training dates.
Maya: Great. Goal: finalize slides by Fri 12pm PT, rehearsal Mon 4/11 16:00. If you can't make the rehearsal, please DM recorded notes. Thanks team :thumbsup:
